subject: Supplier intake kickoff — PO workflow, onboarding forms & success metrics
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@lumencloud.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier intake kickoff — PO workflow, onboarding forms & success metrics

Hi Anita / Ian —

Thanks for the materials you shared last week. Before we create the PO and move billing over, we'd like to run a short supplier onboarding kickoff to align on:

- Required vendor paperwork and signatures (vendor form, W-9/eqv)
- Redwood PO process and expected lead times for first invoice
- SSO/SCIM or API keys for usage reporting (if applicable)
- Success criteria for activation (test calls, SLA targets, access roles)
- Owners and a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones

Proposed 30-minute slots (PST):
- Tue Apr 19, 9:30–10:00am
- Tue Apr 19, 3:00–3:30pm
- Wed Apr 20, 10:00–10:30am

Suggested agenda (I can share a short doc):
1) Introductions & scope (5m)
2) Required docs / attachments checklist (8m)
3) PO process walkthrough (5m)
4) Technical access & reporting (7m)
5) Next steps / MAP (5m)

Attaching our onboarding checklist and PO-process flow so you can review before the call. Please confirm a slot and add any additional stakeholders.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_po-process-flow.pdf (pdf)
From: Anita Shah <anita@lumencloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Ian Mercer <ian.mercer@lumencloud.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier intake kickoff — PO workflow, onboarding forms & success metrics

Thanks Dylan — Wed Apr 20 at 10am PST works best for us.

I'll include our procurement lead, and we'll have the completed vendor intake form on hand. Quick note: our AP team needs 10 business days after PO issuance to set up bank details. Will that timeline be OK for your billing start?

Best,
Anita Shah
Sr. Procurement Operations Manager
LumenCloud

Attachments: lumen_vendor_form_filled.pdf (pdf)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier intake kickoff — PO workflow, onboarding forms & success metrics

Noted — 10 business days for AP is fine. Two operational asks for the call:
1) We'll need a single point of contact for invoice escalation (name + email).
2) Confirm whether LumenCloud requires a specific PO reference format (so our finance team can pre-fill).

Also adding Rishi for SLA alignment and Laura for vendor setup logistics.

- Priyom
Head of Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-04-19T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier intake kickoff — PO workflow, onboarding forms & success metrics

Adding the call invite for Wed Apr 20 10:00–10:30am PST — calendar invite sent to all.

Prep notes I've uploaded to the shared Drive (quick checklist):
- Confirmed vendor legal name for PO: LumenCloud, Inc.
- Required attachments: vendor_form, W-9 (or local equivalent), SOC_attestation (if applicable)
- Finance needs preferred remit address + EFT/ACH bank details after PO is accepted

Link: https://drive.company/shared/Procurement/LC_onboarding_brief

See you on Wednesday.

Laura Bennett

Cc: Anita Shah <anita@lumencloud.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T10:04:00-07:00

Thanks for the agenda — quick answers before the call:
- Invoice escalation contact: treasurer@lumencloud.com (cc: billing@lumencloud.com)
- PO reference: Please use format REDWOOD-<deal-number>-LC (e.g., REDWOOD-0453-LC)
- We can provide SOC attestation via our security portal; will bring link to the call.

Ian
Director, Finance & Ops
LumenCloud
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-04-20T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier intake kickoff — PO workflow, onboarding forms & success metrics

Great — captured those items. I'll circulate a short MAP (mutual action plan) after the call with owners and target dates:
- PO issued: target Apr 25 (owner: Redwood Finance)
- Bank details collected & AP set: Apr 29 (owner: LumenCloud AP)
- Test API / reporting access: May 3 (owner: Redwood Platform)
- First invoice processed: May 6 (owner: Redwood Finance)

If any of those dates look tight given your internal 10-business-day setup, flag now and we'll adjust.

Thanks all.

Laura Bennett
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
